use_cases: Display current time in a classic analog format for dashboards
Show real-time clock in healthcare monitoring applications
Add decorative time display to educational or productivity apps
Serve as a visual time indicator in media or streaming platforms
Provide time reference in fintech trading or financial dashboards
ai_summary: A real-time analog clock component with a dark slate-800 background and emerald-400 hour markers. Features traditional clock mechanics with hour numbers, minute markers, and rotating hands that update every second. The component uses trigonometric calculations to position clock elements and provides a modern, minimalist aesthetic suitable for dashboard or application time display.
